narration_transcript: Survey Results Summary statistics Quantiles and boxplots Python/Colab Outlook Quantiles Quantiles are cutoff points that partition an ordered sample or dataset into equal-sized groups. • A median splits a sample into two: m • Two terciles split a sample into 3 groups: T1, T2 • Three quartiles split a sample into 4 groups: Q1, Q2, Q3 • Four quintiles split a sample into 5 groups: QU1, QU2, QU3, QU4 • . . . • Ninety-nine [per]centiles split a sample into 100 groups: P1, . . . , P99 Prof. Oke (UMass Amherst) CEE 260/MIE 273 M1b: Summarizing Data September 10, 2026 11 / 16
